info.title: Portal Research Evidence Flow API
info.description: P13 same-origin Screen-04 Evidence Flow Hub. The Hub reads a compact immutable Portal projection and lazy bounded chart series. It never runs QuantBT, scans an artifact/Parquet file, exposes a worker/source path, or lets a browser supply a projection revision.

get.summary: Read compact Evidence Flow Hub state for one run

200.description: Hub summary whose lazy series remain pinned to one immutable evidence revision

304.description: The Hub's semantic representation has not changed (weak comparison)

get.summary: Read one bounded lazy Evidence Flow chart series
get.description: The selected named series carries the same immutable revision semantics as the Hub. A source absence is returned as a typed empty array, never as zero data.

200.description: At most 192 display values from one named evidence series

304.description: The exact immutable revision has not changed (weak comparison: a gzip-weakened W/ tag matches)

CacheControl.description: RF-05 CG-P13-13: every 200/304 is `private, no-cache` (store privately, revalidate before reuse). If-None-Match uses weak comparison, so a gateway-weakened W/ tag still revalidates.

HubEtag.description: Weak semantic validator for the full Hub representation. The separate `revision` field still pins immutable evidence series.

Problem.description: Typed same-origin refusal. It never discloses a database relation, source transport, artifact path, worker identity, lease, raw market data or credential.

RetainedAnalytics.title: ResearchRetainedAnalytics
RetainedAnalytics.description: E11/E14 source-time analytics sealed with one immutable artifact/projection. UTC milliseconds, exact decimals, no compute on GET. Child-tape trade count is not an audited ledger.

net_oos_return.description: Legacy field name; exact Mode 5 facts carry FULL_SAMPLE scope, never an untouched OOS claim.

RetainedAnalyticsV2.title: ResearchRetainedAnalyticsV2
RetainedAnalyticsV2.description: D-AN-01 source-time all-time OOS descriptive analytics. v1 remains readable. No rolling detailed-screen metrics or reconstructed PnL/fills/objectives.

RetainedAnalyticsV2Distributions.title: ResearchAllTimeDistributions
RetainedAnalyticsV2Distributions.description: Additive precomputed OOS companion, including a partial leading month. Daily histogram is all-time, not a trade or per-bar histogram. Original seals remain immutable.

EnrichedAnalysisDistributions.title: ResearchAllTimeDistributions
EnrichedAnalysisDistributions.description: Additive precomputed OOS companion, including a partial leading month. Daily histogram is all-time, not a trade or per-bar histogram. Original seals remain immutable.

RunDeclarationAlphaVersionDeclaration.description: Safe immutable AlphaVersion validator inputs, not raw source, provenance or mutable execution instructions.

CandleOverview.description: E16-R1 bounded true-extrema source overview. It is not a per-bar replay tape and cannot establish execution marker ordering.

SeriesKind.description: ROLLING_SHARPE_63 is QuantBT rolling_sharpe over 63 UTC daily OOS returns (365-day annualisation). ROLLING_BETA_63 stays a typed NOT_PUBLISHED absence until a benchmark series is published; it never carries values.

display_label.description: D1 (audit X2): the short label the hi-fi names a run by (R-WFO-118) - the run's execution profile kind plus its position among the logical runs of that kind in this workspace, ordered by creation. Server-derived by the one rule every read shares, so two readers cannot disagree. Presentation only - run_id remains the identity. null when no label can be derived, and the screen prints the short id rather than a guess.

FoldNavigation.description: Observed P11 snapshot set only; it does not assert a complete source fold plan or boundaries.

count_semantics.description: Native num_trades counts the initial position regime plus position changes per symbol, even for an all-zero series. Not fill count or round-trip executions. Original engine integer is preserved.

DatasetCoverage.description: Immutable P08 snapshot metadata joined inside the run-scoped Hub transaction; no HMD rows or paths.

quality_scope.description: Only qualified observed-source P08 snapshots publish this scope. Range, observed rows and columns are available; calendar gap and missing-bar counts remain null because no expected-session calendar is asserted.

WindowDisclosure.description: P08 immutable per-fold IS/OOS bar counts. Totals sum fold windows and may overlap; sealed holdout count is denied. No results or raw market rows.

claims.description: Seven S04 claim-strip facts; optional during additive rollout. ISSUED requires a sealed QuantBT source fact.

dataset_coverage.description: Optional during bounded rollout; current Hub readers always emit a typed coverage fact.

window_disclosure.description: Optional during rolling deployment; current Hub readers emit a typed window fact.

run_identity.description: Optional during a bounded rolling deployment; new Hub responders always emit it.

fold_navigation.description: Optional during a bounded rolling deployment; it bounds only the published observed P11 fold set.

market_overview.description: Optional during a bounded rolling deployment; legacy P04 runs return the documented typed absence.

run_declaration.description: Immutable bound version declaration and explicit requested overrides. Never current registry defaults or evidence of actual runtime/sampler execution. Optional during additive rollout.

PerformanceMetric.description: RF-05 registry v3 OOS performance fact. ENGINE_DIRECT values are QuantBT 1.1.1 full_report fields over QuantBT's own OOS scope; source_locator names the exact field. Engine sentinels (0.0 for zero variance, inf without losses, 0.0 without exposure) are typed absences, never values.

OosPerformance.description: RF-05 CG-P13-03. Separate from `metrics` (registry v1/v2, frozen by P18 reports). Absent only from a Hub responder that predates RF-05.

Lifecycle.description: RF-05 CG-P13-10/12. display_status uses the Screen-01 run-library rule (job state, else durable state): SUCCEEDED/READY->COMPLETED, RUNNING/CLAIMED/SEALING/CANCEL_REQUESTED->RUNNING, FAILED, CANCELLED, DRAFT, RECOVERY_REQUIRED, otherwise QUEUED. phase is the typed terminal flag; a CANCELLED or FAILED run without evidence is TERMINAL, not an in-progress NOT_READY.

anyOf.description: E10. The stage (and fold, when the source marked one FAILED) at which a failed run stopped.

basis.description: SOURCE_RUNNING_STAGE: the last snapshot had this stage RUNNING. FIRST_UNFINISHED_STAGE: no stage was running; this is the first stage that never completed, so the run stopped before it started.

failed_at.description: Same persisted-snapshot rule as Progress, only for FAILED lifecycle. Null means no exact stopped-stage fact; the browser never infers a failure from RUNNING alone.

RevisionBinding.description: RF-05 CG-P13-11. RUN_INPUT_BOUND: the revision hashes this run id and its requested-spec, effective-spec, dataset-binding and manifest digests with the evidence, so two runs never share it. SOURCE_CONTENT_ONLY: an immutable pre-RF-05 revision naming only evidence bytes; runs with identical output may share it, so match run_id as well.
